scope: Private creative-room recovery over actual native browser WebSockets, encryption and signatures using the owned loopback relay. Existing fake YouTube and synthetic camera fixtures remain controlled provider substitutes. Not hosted, physical-device, separate-network, real Access or real-provider acceptance.
finding: Replacement relay welcomes retained completed snapshot flags, so fresh host snapshots were discarded; missed drawing clears, watch selections and room locks stayed stale. Signature verification continuations could also mutate a replacement membership after the original socket closed.
behavior: Every welcome requests a fresh nonce-bound multipart snapshot; only a complete verified host cut can attest older persistent controls as current. No partial canvas replacement or earlier chat is imported.

Continuous drawing is reconciled with signed clear epochs, absolute point offsets and a bounded atomic journal. Unfinished local strokes, queued envelopes and native encryption spanning a disconnect retain their operations.
A peer may supply drawing but not fresh host control authority or an unsigned sequence floor. A returning creator retains compatible same-epoch art even if an uninitialized newcomer answers first.
Old-socket host clear/video/lock verification cannot mutate a replacement connection. Retired host identity verification cannot replace the returned host or block its snapshot barrier.

Whole meaningful host transactions preserve reservation, signature, local commit and encrypted egress order. Receiving live host frames reserve order before decryption and verification, while chat/drawing/media remain independent.

A newer video choice can cancel obsolete pending signing; a committed action still completes egress in order. Existing watch-loader, autoplay, replay, chat, camera and reconnect contracts remain covered.
Recovery has a 15-second deadline with visible Retry room sync. Known retired presence work wakes an already waiting snapshot barrier; unknown drawing/control decryption remains awaited.

fixtureDetails: Multipart capture seeds 105 canonical strokes through H.apply before a visitor exists; production code captures, chunks, signs, encrypts and relays them. Real pointer strokes span the cut, continue during assembly, and remain unfinished across atomic replacement.
Crypto race gates hold genuine native results; tests observe exact original handler completion after release. No fake successful verification or weakened replay assertion is used.
Each new scenario has a separate local relay namespace; per-relay admission, room capacity, rate and message limits stay intact.
All original failures, setup attempts, screenshots and logs are retained privately; no CI reruns requested.
validation.independentReview: Concrete authority-order, creator-preservation, in-flight encryption, retired-identity and barrier-wake findings were fixed and regression covered. Final source review found no additional concrete issue.

limits: The hosted beta stays at b111bb2/runtime0ee7705e during the original normal eight-hour expiry observation. Neither this recovery correction nor its preceding private-history fix is deployed there.

Already loaded older clients require refresh for offset/epoch drawing during recovery. Unsupported legacy drawing, conflicts, missing ranges and capacity exhaustion show explicit retry/failure instead of claiming lossless recovery.
No new message delivery acknowledgment or uninterrupted eight-hour socket guarantee is claimed.
Physical Safari/backgrounding, Windows/Linux installation and audio, second verified owner/co-host identity, TURN and human/Karen acceptance remain outstanding.
